mechanism_narrative: A declining trend in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in a month, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a misalignment between housing demand and labor market strength, indicating an overheating economy that triggers a correction in equity markets, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, with the effect most pronounced over a 60-day horizon.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which correlates with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST has risen over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 in a single month, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 5.0% and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals stagflationary pressures that reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 98.0), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over a 5-day horizon as supply chain disruptions and weak production dampen market sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 98.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
